This is the v1 corpus for the knobs ADR 0115 left without a v2 form and ADR 0117 gives one: `generateContentConfig.toolConfig` (now `tool_choice:`), `thinkingConfig.includeThoughts` (read by nothing, so dropped), and the effort words `xhigh` and `max` (now levels of `reasoning:`). No shipped YAML used them, so these three files are written for the test, in the v1 spelling a 1.1.0 file would carry, one per provider family: Gemini, Claude, and the effort-word providers (Kimi, OpenAI, xAI, Ollama). `tests/toolChoiceEffort.test.ts` runs `scripts/yaml_codemod.ts` over each, asserts that nothing stays under `generateContentConfig`, and checks that every agent sends the same request body to its provider before and after. Nothing loads these files as live syndicates, and they are never edited.
